method: Read-only hash, XML dependency, promoted render, and measured-frame provenance audit; no simulations rerun.
scope: Owner/source acceptance only. Publication remains gated by fresh native, browser and robotic integration evidence.

assets.scope: Owner reference, geometry/contact and source/render provenance checks.
assets.integration_acceptance: Separate fresh native/browser integration reports are required by package_alignment_results.py.
limits: Exterior dimensions, loads, material properties and holder/stand relief dimensions remain reconstruction estimates; no manufacturer CAD or metrology is claimed.
Collision checks cover the named assemblies and finite sampled poses, not every possible configuration or every inserted screw/bearing seam.
Native contact is numerically soft; contact regressions measure and limit penetration rather than interpreting it as calibrated material indentation.
The optical-axis check is geometric. Internal optical prescriptions and lower condenser transmission are not ray-traced.
Existing cable models and renderer behavior are preserved; these repairs do not add robot-driven cable dynamics.

assets.scope: Owner reference, geometry/contact and source/render provenance checks.
assets.integration_acceptance: Separate fresh native/browser integration reports are required by package_alignment_results.py.
limits: The audit covers the listed optical assemblies, sampled poses and measured approach/retraction trajectories; arbitrary robot approaches are not certified.
Reference images establish visible construction; mount dimensions, optical prescriptions and material/force parameters remain uncalibrated.
Flexible services retain prescribed visual deformation without contact or strain dynamics.
Source-only high-Z/tilt commands can geometrically overlap the objective. Their actual finite-force equilibria and retractions are checked separately.
The sole detailed-mesh overlap allowance is 5 micrometers of thin-axis bounding-box overlap at intended loaded objective/clamp-head contact. Fixed/moving supports receive no such allowance.

The full knob/table envelopes are analytical, while the 567 service configurations are a sampled grid with the stamp assembly at rest/retracted; they are not a continuous all-pairs configuration-space proof.
Unmarked mount sizes, screw pitch and concealed thrust-screw internals remain photo-supported estimates.

limits: The audit covers the listed optical assemblies, sampled poses and measured approach/retraction trajectories; arbitrary robot approaches are not certified.
Reference images establish visible construction; mount dimensions, optical prescriptions and material/force parameters remain uncalibrated.
Flexible services retain prescribed visual deformation without contact or strain dynamics.
Pupil rays demonstrate geometric access to both pads. They do not reconstruct the unknown internal stereo channels or claim that opaque tools never obscure the specimen.
The probe force test explicitly inserts a temporary obstacle below the glass; it is not delivered instrument hardware. The existing operating envelope is tested separately and remains clear.
Focus wheels remain visual controls; the axial focus slide has finite-force fixture actuation and native lower-optics contacts.
The 20 mm support setback, 10 mm visible head setback and collet proportions are photo-supported reconstruction dimensions, not factory measurements.
The 8:1 coupling is an equivalent small-displacement mechanism; it does not reconstruct the concealed closed-chain linkage.
Tool forces, ultrasound, heat and actual bond formation remain uncalibrated.

assets.scope: Owner reference, geometry/contact and source/render provenance checks.
assets.integration_acceptance: Separate fresh native/browser integration reports are required by package_alignment_results.py.
limits: Exterior and hidden relay dimensions are estimates, not manufacturer CAD.
The folded optical relay establishes a connected geometric path; refractive calibration and optical image formation are not solved.
The engage encoder remains an uncoupled control. Coarse approach, calibrated tip forces and nanoscanning are outside this alignment repair.
The parked holder has about1.3 mm tip standoff. Full holder service lift requires drawer withdrawal; native contact also blocks a forced lift into the objective.
Socket/puck support and holder contacts are analytic compound approximations. Raw laboratory media remain private.

Actual evaluated triangles and multi-ray containment witnesses at466 valid drawer/holder poses and an intentionally invalid full docked lift. Internal objective assembly joints and intended casting attachments are not moving clearance pairs. Optical ray segments verify geometric bores, not image-formation calibration.

Compiled native sites and mask-independent cylinder/holder distances over466 valid states. Fixtures-disabled torque test requires native contacts to stop a docked lift, with contact-pair removal as a negative control. Existing access/cycle fixture tasks are regression tests, not an AFM scanning calibration.
The 10 micrometer pyramid supplies visible tip geometry and a measurement site. Native contacts use objective, holder and chip proxies; nanometric tip-sample interactions are not simulated.

limits: Tests cover pickup and placement fixture trajectories and a causal low-approach failure control, not arbitrary robot motion.

The receiving tray and pickup seat are benchmark fixtures, absent from the lab photographs.
